Subject: MSA Intake — Party binding, billing cadence & SLA questions

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. To get contracting moving, attaching our standard MSA template and a small party matrix that helps us populate exhibits. A few quick asks so we can scope the order form and redlines: 

- Confirm the legal entity name you intend to sign (including any DBA / affiliate that should appear on the Order Form).
- Billing cadence: monthly vs. annual prepay? Who should receive invoices and what's the billing contact?
- Data residency: will HelioFin require EU-only or specific region residency for production data?
- SLA expectations: are there any SLA thresholds beyond our standard enterprise SLA we should be aware of?
- Signature flow: single exec or multi-signer (billing + legal)? Any internal PO process?

We usually ask for the party matrix back with contacts and any initial clause asks. If you prefer, we can run an initial redline pass and return our comments.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Template.docx, Party_Matrix_Template.xlsx

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync with Kimberly (legal lead) and Marissa (CS lead) to walk through billing/residency items. Are you available tomorrow morning (Thu 6/19)?

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi David —

Thanks for the materials. Attached is our draft SOW and a partially filled party matrix. Quick answers below:

- Legal entity: HelioFin, Inc. (EIN 12-3456789). Billing should be to HelioFin AP (ap@heliofin.com).
- Billing cadence: prefer annual prepay, but we need net-30 invoice for internal finance. Will Helio accept invoicing terms as net-30 if we commit annual spend?
- Data residency: production data must persist in us-west-2; dev/staging can be multi-region.
- SLA: standard enterprise SLA is fine, but we need a 99.9% uptime commitment for API endpoints used in live payments.
- Signature flow: Legal (me) + Finance (AP manager) must sign off; final exec signature likely the CFO. We have a PO process that issues a PO number before signature.

I've attached HelioFin_SOW_v1.pdf and the filled party matrix (partial). We also flagged two clauses in your MSA we anticipate redlining: limitation of liability (cap calculation) and data deletion/residency wording.

We can do the sync Thu 6/19 at 10:00 PT. If that works, send a calendar invite.

Best,
Sara

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@heliofin.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA Intake — Party binding, billing cadence & SLA questions

Thanks David / Sara —

Reviewed the SOW and party matrix; pointers and next steps below: 

1) Billing cadence / PO: We can support two commercial options on the Order Form as you suggested. For annual prepay with net-30 invoicing ask: we will document an annual commitment clause and include an invoice flow that allows Helio to pay within net-30 while still recognizing the preferred annual pricing. There is a small collections exposure; recommend Finance (Marissa) confirm tolerance for invoice lag and funding triggers.

2) Data residency & deletion: We'll accept prod residency restriction to us-west-2. Need to add a residency carve in Exhibit B and a data deletion SLA for deprovisioning within 30 days post-termination for production data. Also suggest clarifying backups/geographic replication (we'll say backups may be cross-region for DR; production data residency remains us-west-2).

3) SLA: 99.9% for payment-critical endpoints is reasonable as an ask. We'll propose 99.9% uptime with credit-based remedies; exceptions for scheduled maintenance and force majeure. If Helio needs a higher financial remedy, escalate to Sales leadership for approval.

4) LoL cap: we'll propose a middle-ground: cap at the greater of (12 months' fees or $2M) instead of pure fees cap. That should be a starting position; happy to run numbers with Sales to see commercial impact.

5) Signature flow: We'll prepare a signatory flow that accepts PO numbers and supports dual sign-off (Legal + Finance) before exec signature. Provide DocuSign route and a separate manual-sign option for enterprise procurement.

Action items: 
- Kimberly: I will prepare a first-pass redline (MS Word tracked) on the MSA focusing on LOC, residency, and data deletion by EOD Fri 6/20.
- Marissa: please confirm if finance is comfortable with invoice lag for annual-prepay pricing or if we need stricter funding milestones.
- David: please upload the final party matrix and SOW to the deal in HubSpot and share the link to the Helio contacts.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345
DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/rec/embedded?envelopeId=abc-789

Kimberly Park
